title: use_emulator + custom endpoint not rejected
description: The AzureBackendConfig doc comment says 'Do not set both use_emulator and endpoint — Azurite\'s well-known URL is implied by use_emulator = true.' But neither the config validation in transit/src/config.rs nor reader/src/config.rs enforces this. An operator who sets both will get surprising behavior: the object_store MicrosoftAzureBuilder accepts both, and the result depends on which internal builder option wins, which is not documented in the stoa config layer. Since both settings conflict, the config validator should reject the combination with a clear error.
